items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: But he has helped Joe a lot too.

ctx.x: When you said old man Robichaux did you mean John Robichaux, the old violin player?

The old violin player. He used to play at the Lyric Theater when I heard it. I couldn't even go there. I was a kid then, around 18, 19, 20. I mean I've heard about him and Joe has told me plenty about it. But he has helped Joe a lot too. But still, Joe has stayed within that same track. He hasn't moved. I doubted Joe is a better piano player now than he was in 1925. See, because he never would try to improve himself. But he was a good piano player.
But I mean, I would- He had some old records of Lee Collins, sounded real good on those, back 1928 or 1909. Yeah.
